title: Understanding Cu <sup>+2</sup> binding with DNA: A molecular dynamics study comparing Cu <sup>2+</sup> and Mg <sup>2+</sup> binding to the Dickerson DNA
authors: Angad Sharma; Hari O. S. Yadav; Pradipta Bandyopadhyay
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究Cu2+与Dickerson DNA的磷酸基团及大小沟结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系中的金属离子-DNA结合，方法为MD模拟，但对象非TF-DNA，且未涉及蛋白结合，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Cu 2+ ions led DNA damage by reactive oxygen species (ROS) is widely known biological phenomena. The ionic radii of Cu 2+ and Mg 2+ being similar, the binding of Cu 2+ ions to DNA is expected to be similar to that of the Mg 2+ ions. However, little is known how Cu 2+ ions bind in different parts (phosphate, major and minor grooves) of a double-strand (ds) DNA, especially at atomic level. In the present study, we employ molecular dynamic (MD) simulations to investigate the binding of Cu 2+ ions with the Dickerson DNA, a B-type dodecamer double stranded (ds) DNA. The binding characteristics of Cu 2+ and Mg 2+ ions with this dsDNA are compared to get an insight into the differences and similarities in binding behavior of both ions. Unlike Mg 2+ ions, the first hydration shell of Cu 2+ is found to be labile, thus it shows both direct and indirect binding with the dsDNA, i.e., binding through displacement of water from the hydration shell or through the hydration shell. Though the binding propensity of Cu 2+ ions with dsDNA is observed relatively stronger, the binding order to phosphates, major groove, and minor groove is found qualitatively similar (phosphates > major groove > minor groove) for both ions. The study gives a deep understanding of Cu 2+ binding to DNA, which could be helpful in rationalizing the Cu 2+ led ROS-mediated DNA damage.
abstract_zh: Cu 2+离子通过活性氧（ROS）导致DNA损伤是广为人知的生物现象。由于Cu 2+和Mg 2+的离子半径相似，Cu 2+离子与DNA的结合预期与Mg 2+离子相似。然而，关于Cu 2+离子如何与双链（ds）DNA的不同部分（磷酸基团、大沟和小沟）结合，尤其是在原子水平上的了解甚少。在本研究中，我们采用分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟来研究Cu 2+离子与Dickerson DNA（一种B型十二聚体双链DNA）的结合。通过比较Cu 2+和Mg 2+离子与该dsDNA的结合特性，以深入了解两种离子在结合行为上的异同。与Mg 2+离子不同，Cu 2+的第一水合壳层被发现是不稳定的，因此它表现出与dsDNA的直接和间接结合，即通过从水合壳层中置换水分子或通过水合壳层进行结合。尽管观察到Cu 2+离子与dsDNA的结合倾向相对更强，但两种离子对磷酸基团、大沟和小沟的结合顺序在定性上相似（磷酸基团 > 大沟 > 小沟）。该研究为Cu 2+与DNA的结合提供了深入理解，这可能有助于合理化Cu 2+诱导的ROS介导的DNA损伤。
